youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.hook_rule: First 3-5 seconds must introduce high-stakes gameplay moment or challenge.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.hook_rule: 0-3s visual shock or curiosity hook. Faster pacing, captions burned into center.

instagram.name: Instagram Reels
instagram.hook_rule: Aesthetic high-contrast cover, strong call to action in final 3 seconds.

x.name: X (Twitter)
x.hook_rule: Claim in first 8 words, specific game title in first 10 words. Write for retweets and DM shares.
